create_COMHeightEstimator: create a COMHeightEstimator instance with a quadruped robot and initial CoM height of 0.45
update_com_height_estimate: update the COM height estimate by calling update with the current simulation time
get_estimated_com_height: get the estimated center of mass height from the COMHeightEstimator property
reset_com_height_estimator: reset the COMHeightEstimator to its initial CoM height and leg indices
set_com_estimate_leg_indices: set which leg indices the COMHeightEstimator uses to estimate the center of mass height
